stumbles.quote: Interference LUT colour is within 0.07 ΔE76.
stumbles.why: LUT is never expanded, and it's unclear what it maps (film thickness to colour?). It also doesn't say what the colour is compared against, so I can't tell what the 0.07 figure means.

stumbles.quote: Thick film sinks toward your phone's tilt while black film spreads from the top until it pops.
stumbles.why: 'Black film' is never defined. I'd guess it means the thinnest film, but the text doesn't say. 'Pops' is also unexplained: does the simulation end or reset?

stumbles.quote: tested on a software GPU, untested on a phone.
stumbles.why: The simulation responds to phone tilt, but it was never tried on a phone. That makes it unclear whether the tilt feature works. 'Software GPU' is also vague.

point: A WebGPU soap-film simulation that reacts to phone tilt, with film thickness driving colour and a film that thins and pops, but only tested on a software GPU and not on a phone.
